# Trial results (generated by scripts/results_table.py)

Every row is one replay of `scripts/scenario.py`. *Save clicks* is counted in the client journal; *records on host* is the independent check read from the host's storage after the run (the executor never reads it). *Model calls* counts calls to the local vision model. Each replay starts from an empty host, which is why every saved record is R-10481. Operator actions and faults are played by the test harness (`scripts/scenario.py`); the executor runs as a separate process and is not told what will happen.
